ResearchGPT 30-Paper Candidate Golden Dataset
=============================================

Status: CANDIDATE GOLD — NOT HUMAN-VERIFIED.
Source of truth: the 30 physical PDFs supplied in the conversation.
The original PDFs are unchanged and are identified by source_filename in each PXXX.json.

Files
-----
P001.json ... P030.json: one per paper.
INDEX.json: manifest and aggregate counts.

Each paper contains
-------------------
- 01_metadata through 13_limitations
- TABLE_GROUND_TRUTH: table inventory, captions, reconstructed table contents, cells and header paths
- CLAIM_TABLE_LINKING: cross references, candidate claim-table relationships, candidate claim-cell pairs
- numeric_normalization_cases
- extraction_audit

Important
---------
This is deliberately marked candidate_not_verified. PDF text/layout extraction can mis-segment tables, especially multi-column pages, continuation tables, scanned regions, or complex headers. Candidate gold pairs are never treated as verified merely because a number matches. Human visual verification against the original PDF is required before using the dataset as the final evaluation oracle.
